current: The field is never read and the behaviour it selects does not exist. NO PLUGIN UPDATE AT ALL: `availableUpdateVersion` is declared at packages/shared/src/capabilities/resolver.ts:683 and :747, passed through at :2201 and packages/shared/src/capabilities/views.ts:403, projected on the wire at packages/shared/src/protocol/capabilities.ts:299 — and assigned by nobody, so views.ts:443 `canUpdate: !!plugin.availableUpdateVersion` is permanently false. `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER`/`FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS` have no reader in `packages/`, `apps/` or `scripts/` (grep -a, empty). Every `autoUpdate` identifier in tracked source belongs to apps/electron/src/main/auto-update.ts — the electron-updater app-binary updater, a different subsystem. The comment at registry-source.ts:693 already claims its allowlist gate covers "the background auto-update", naming a mechanism this fork does not have.
divergence: Not a key-name mismatch and not a narrower implementation: `autoUpdate` is absent from the row shape entirely, and both halves of the behaviour it selects are absent too. (1) The key is dropped silently at `deliveredRows` (managed-marketplace-entries.ts:384-406) — no parse, no validation, no drop record. (2) There is no post-startup refresh path: registration is lazy and read-path driven, and the only catalog refresh is the user-clicked `upgrade()`. (3) The "update its installed plugins" half has no implementation anywhere — `availableUpdateVersion` has no producer, so the Update action is permanently unavailable rather than merely unscheduled. (4) The documented default rule (`true` for official Anthropic marketplaces, `false` for the rest) has no expression; there is no per-registry auto-update predicate at all. Note that `autoUpdate` sits BESIDE `source` in the entry, whereas the neighbouring `skipLfs` (settings.md:877) sits INSIDE the `source` object and is lost one function earlier in `deliveredMarketplaceSource` (:285-317), which flattens that object to a bare string — different fix site, do not conflate them.

Fix the comment at :693, which already asserts the gate covers "the background auto-update" that does not yet exist.

Give the field a producer. In the resolution-input provider (`createCapabilityResolutionInputProviderV2`, wired at packages/server-core/src/bootstrap/storage-runtime.ts:311-325), match each installed entry's `origin.listingId` + `marketplaceRegistryId` against the cached catalog row reachable through `MarketplaceRegistryController.findCatalogItem` (registry-source.ts:471-490) and set `availableUpdateVersion` when `MarketplaceCatalogItem.version` (packages/shared/src/marketplace/types.ts:346) is newer than `PluginInstalledEntryV2.version` (read at resolver.ts:2199). Reuse, do not add, the update primitive: `install(source, options)` (:125-130 → `installUnlocked` :132-174) already re-materializes a bundle and commits a fresh instance, and already emits `plugin.install.version_mismatch` (:145-154) when the listing and bundle versions disagree. The auto-update step calls it with the stored origin source of each plugin whose `availableUpdateVersion` is set. No new install path, and every existing trust/allowlist gate stays on the call.

blastRadius: Crosses BOTH a persistence and a wire boundary — a risk trigger in this repo. Persistence: `PluginMarketplaceRegistry` is the `marketplaces.json` row (packages/shared/src/plugins/store.ts:42-64) read and written by `PluginStore` on every add/upgrade/remove (registry-source.ts:835, :879, :915-920). Wire: `SafeInstalledPlugin.availableUpdateVersion` / `actions.canUpdate` (packages/shared/src/protocol/capabilities.ts:299, :337) go from dead to live, so the renderer plugin/Sources row menu starts offering an Update action that today never appears. Managed-policy readers: `ManagedPiPolicyV1` (managed-policy.ts:158), `MANAGED_PI_POLICY_KEYS` and `isManagedPolicyTightening` (asserted in packages/shared/src/agent/__tests__/managed-policy-reread.test.ts:103, :139 — widening an entry's shape must not be classed as a tightening on re-read), and the doctor text at packages/shared/src/config/config-doctor.ts:388 plus packages/shared/src/plugins/mandated-plugins.ts:34, which both name `extraKnownMarketplaces`. Callers of the registry controller: packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/marketplace.ts:105, :192-195, :368-378 and packages/server-core/src/bootstrap/storage-runtime.ts:302-313. Imported-plugin path: an auto-update reinstall re-runs the format adapters and the whole install trust gate, so Claude- and Codex-format bundles are re-materialized unattended — the security-relevant part of this change and the reason the allowlist re-check at registry-source.ts:695 must stay on the path. Note also that the untracked build artifact packages/pi-agent-server/dist/index.js carries upstream's own `autoUpdate` registry schema; it is a bundle, not our source, and nothing in our source reads it.
userImpact: An administrator who follows settings.md and writes `"autoUpdate": true` on an `extraKnownMarketplaces` entry in managed settings gets silence: the key is dropped at parse with no drop record and no doctor warning, so the policy looks accepted. The marketplace is still registered, but its catalog only refreshes when a user opens the marketplace browse surface, or clicks Upgrade on that registry by hand. The installed plugins from it never update: the plugin row's Update action is permanently unavailable because `canUpdate` is hard-false, so a user cannot even see that a newer version exists. Concretely, a fleet pinned to an internal marketplace stays on whatever plugin version was installed on day one, indefinitely, and both the administrator and the user believe otherwise.
